# RENU Property Partners

> Property management for rental owners in Sarnia and Lambton County, Ontario, Canada. Led by founder Priscilla. Real estate investors since 2008.

## Services
- Tenant placement: we find, screen and sign your tenant. Screening checks legal, verifiable facts, the same way for every applicant.
- Full property management: rent collected, repairs arranged, records kept. Tenant questions, repairs and after-hours emergencies come to our team.
- LTB paperwork support: help with Landlord and Tenant Board forms, serving notices on time, rent records, evidence and hearing prep.

## Area served
Sarnia and Lambton County, Ontario.

## About
RENU is a family business. Our own rentals are in Sarnia and Lambton County, under the same rules as our clients'. Founder Priscilla attends Landlord and Tenant Board hearings every week.
